name: MEA Local — Extracted Review Service (Quarkus)
_comment: FORWARD-REFERENCE (r02-plan S8+, not yet exercised by S6): points the SAME behavior-equivalence suite at the extracted Quarkus Review service (examples/15-review-service/) once it exists, on its own port so it can run side-by-side with the monolith during the strangler cutover. Only the Review Context Contract folder is meaningful against this target; the checkout/inventory/payment scenarios are monolith-only until Order/Inventory/Payment are themselves extracted. Update `baseUrl` here (and/or point it at the Camel strangler proxy's Review route) once S8 stands the service up — the collection itself must NOT change (that is the equivalence gate, DRQ-014).
